notes.title: A goodbye to everyone.
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We wanted to share some heartbreaking news about the future of Dust. 

Today, we encountered an issue with Windows and weren't able to sign in, so we couldn't access Dust, and now the project is gone. 

We didn't want it to end like this; we wanted it to happen after we completed the story. 

We will still make games and may return to the Dust storyline.

I will notify everyone when we create a new game. Stay tuned for the VR game called The FRONT END. 

We are sorry it ended this way and wanted to say our goodbyes. Goodbye, everyone.

 Thank you for making our dreams come true and playing our game.
